inlines.v: EMIGRA'TION, noun Removal of inhabitants from one country or state to another, for the purpose of residence, as from Europe to America, or in America, from the Atlantic States to the Western. The removal of persons from house to house in the same town, state or kingdom is not called emigration but simple removal.
